githubWorkflowStateSnapshot.source: Parent read-only GitHub workflows API snapshot
githubWorkflowStateSnapshot.note: Observed snapshot only. Re-read exact paths before mutation; current API state may differ.

limitations: This is a verified first operational freeze scope, not an assertion that all 644 workflows are exhaustively classified.

GitHub workflow states come from the identified read-only API snapshot; active-run/job state and each exact workflow state must be fetched again immediately before changes. YAML trigger presence does not prove API enabled state.
No workflow has been run, disabled or cancelled by this audit. No storage object, owner switch, lease or server process has been changed.
Disable all verified triggering callers as well as reusable definitions; do not assume disabling only a reusable workflow prevents callers.
Historical marker, embedded operation and shared release writers remain outside the first allowlist until their execution and protected dependencies are reviewed.
Actual VM cron/systemd/process inventory is not available from source alone. Source-tree scheduler findings do not prove no external writers.
Keep administrative source switches, encyclopedia, calculation engines, saved quotes, CRM jobs and release checks intact.
Existing web-request-time caches and admin-authorized writers are not frozen by a GitHub workflow disable operation.
note: Historical code audit only. The applied scope and actual outcome are linked in README.md. This summary does not claim all 644 workflows are exhaustively retired.
